desc: The ULTRX Cinder Safety Glasses deliver exceptional eye protection for various environments, making them a must-have for any activity requiring superior safety. Ideal for the shooting range, construction sites, or DIY projects, these glasses offer crystal-clear vision and robust durability. Featuring high-impact polycarbonate lenses and a full wrap clear frame, they ensure comprehensive protection while maintaining an unobstructed view. Perfect for those who demand both safety and clarity.
